title: Find a compact credential-payload corpus packet
description: Find and pin a compact permissively licensed complete source scope for password or credential-payload semantics distinct from Gitea access tokens and Keycloak credential entities. Use scanner-blind proposed annotations and a human review worksheet; do not accept labels without review.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Prepared and materialized a compact Ory Kratos password-credential packet: complete 21-line Apache-2.0 Go type, with one proposed password-verifier decision and one migration-control negative. This deliberately complements rather than repeats Gitea bearer tokens and Keycloak generic credential payloads. Manifest tests pass; no record is accepted.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Proposed Ory Kratos password packet is on develop via PR #5 (tests/benchmark/repos/ory-kratos-password/). Closing this find-and-prepare sub-task. Acceptance remains DATAP-c66199.
